blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — While admitting there is room for improvement regarding budget transparency, Bataan Rep. Albert Garcia has maintained that the House has been working on existing and new reforms to ensure a clear process in crafting the appropriations plan. In a press briefing on Monday, Garcia, vice chair of the House committee on appropriations, which prepares the General Appropriations Bill (GAB), reminded the public that they have continued the reforms initiated in 2025 for the 2026 budget cycle, and are looking toward initiating more measures to boost transparency.
